text:
Ravi Shenoy: Noticed a heap of small docs failures from the last optimize-toolkit sweep. Two things hit CI: the Go kv-prefetch example fails to compile and the JS batching snippet uses an old `batchSize` param name.
Elena Grigori: Thanks for flagging. I just ran samplegen and it reports the Go example uses `client.NewOld` which no longer exists. Also a stray link to /docs/quant-profiles-old that 404s.
Jae Kim: I can take the JS snippet. Should we rename param to `maxBatch` and show the recommended heuristic snippet? e.g. `maxBatch: Math.min(64, Math.floor(throughput/3))` with an inline comment.
doc-bot: [automated] samplegen v0.4.2 results for branch docs/optkit-fix: 2 failing examples (optimize/kv-prefetch.md [go], optimize/batching.md [js]) - see https://ci.internal.redwood/ci/9981/logs
Ravi Shenoy: Elena — can you patch the Go snippet to use the new constructor pattern and remove OldAuth? Suggest: `client := rd.NewClient(ctx, rd.WithAPIKey(os.Getenv("REDWOOD_API_KEY")))` and update imports.
Elena Grigori: Yup. I'm editing the markdown to replace code fence and adding a one-line migration tip in optimize/migration-notes.md: "Go SDK v2 changed constructor signatures; update OldClient -> rd.NewClient(...)"
Jae Kim: I'll prepare the JS patch and add a short note in batching.md recommending `maxBatch` be tuned by percentile of request size distribution. I'll include an example and a small caveat about latency-SLO tradeoffs.
Ravi Shenoy: Can one of you also fix the quant-profile anchor that changed? The table anchor is now `#quant-profiles-table` instead of the old slug.
Elena Grigori: Fixed anchor and added a redirect comment for older URLs. Draft PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4199 (Go + link fix).
Jae Kim: Draft PR for JS change: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4200 (includes a short heuristic and example).
Ravi Shenoy: Assign reviewers: @Elena Grigori will self-review Go changes, @Jae Kim can ping SDK-owners for JS. I'll run samplegen against the PRs and re-trigger CI.
doc-bot: [automated] samplegen run queued for PRs #4199, #4200.
Elena Grigori: Quick local compile: added `examples/test_examples.go` snippet check to catch regressions. All green locally.
Jae Kim: Linted and previewed batching.md; updated code block and added a note: "If you need extreme low latency, prefer smaller maxBatch and KV-caching; for throughput-sensitive workloads increase maxBatch and enable auto-batching."
Ravi Shenoy: CI passed for both PRs. Merging shortly. Please file a follow-up ticket to sweep other optimize examples for SDK changes and broken anchors.
Elena Grigori: Filed ticket DOCS-827: optimize example audit (assigned to docs-rotation). Added checklist: Go, Python, JS snippet sanity, quant links, samplegen smoke.
Jae Kim: :thumbsup: Closing this thread after merges.
doc-bot: [automated] PRs merged: #4199, #4200 (merge commits 1715010201, 1715010350).
